name: failureTime
description: Date and time when backup failed (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format)

name: backupType
description: Type of backup that was attempted (FULL, INCREMENTAL, or DIFFERENTIAL)

name: lastSuccessfulBackup
description: Date and time of last successful backup, or 'Never' if no previous backup

name: attemptNumber
description: Number of consecutive failed attempts (defaults to 1 if not tracked)

name: errorMessage
description: Detailed error message describing why the backup failed

name: nextBackupTime
description: Date and time of next scheduled backup attempt
